title: こたつで千ピース
mood: hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud, a grandpa's personal-best comedy
subject: a retired salaryman alone at the kotatsu over one winter weekend, timing himself on a stopwatch to finish the 1000-piece Mount Fuji jigsaw his grandson did in nine hours at New Year, sorting edge pieces into a biscuit tin and losing an hour to a sky made of nothing but blue
caption: Japanese hyperpop, 2020s Tokyo netlabel lineage with experimental electronic edges. Detuned supersaw stabs, blown-out distorted 808 kick and sub bass, glitch-stuttered synth arpeggio, bitcrushed snare rolls that stop dead before each chorus. Maximal, clipped and glitchy production with sudden drop-outs to near silence. Male mid-range vocal, fast clipped deadpan delivery that breaks into a shouted chorus, natural doubling only. 160 BPM, F# minor. Hyperactive, nerdy and stubbornly proud. No autotune, no trap flow, no ballad piano, no guitar band, no EDM festival build.
lyrics:
[Intro - glitchy detuned synth stabs, distorted 808 kick]

[Verse 1]
正月に孫が 九時間で仕上げた
千ピースの富士山 箱ごと置いてった
土曜の朝 こたつに広げて
ストップウォッチ 押してみる

[Pre-Chorus]
まず端っこ 端っこだけ
煎餅の缶に 選り分けて

[Chorus]
千ピース 千ピース
空が全部 同じ青
ばあさん言う 「まだやってるの」
やってるよ 千ピース

[Verse 2]
老眼鏡 二本かけ替える
雪のとこは 白しかない
一時間かけて はまったのが一個
声出して 喜んだ

[Bridge - synths drop out, kick only]
日曜の夜 残り三つ
こたつ布団 めくったら
落ちてた ひとつ

[Chorus]
千ピース 千ピース
十一時間 孫に負けた
ばあさん言う 「でも綺麗ね」
写真撮って 孫に送る

[Outro - glitch stutters, synths collapse to silence]
